Subject: Vendor account activation & documentation — next steps for HelioMetrics

Hi Samantha / HelioMetrics team,

Thanks again for choosing Redwood — excited to get you set up. To activate your vendor account and provision PO capabilities we need three items from your side: a signed W-9 (if US entity) or W-8BEN-E (if non-US), the completed vendor intake form (attached fillable PDF), and your VAT registration or VAT-exemption documentation if applicable.

Quick checklist and timeline:
- Signed W-9/W-8BEN-E — required to create tax profile and remit payments
- Completed vendor_form_fillable.pdf — this captures legal name, remit-to address, banking remit instructions (ACH/Wire), and primary invoice contact
- VAT documentation (if outside US) — optional for US suppliers but necessary for EU customers/transactions

Our target: receive docs by Tue, Aug 25 so Finance can create the vendor record and issue PO. Payment terms default to Net-45 unless otherwise negotiated. Once the W-9/form is accepted we will assign a PO number and share the PO PDF for invoicing.

Attachments: vendor_form_fillable.pdf (fillable PDF, 1 page)

Please reply to this thread with attachments or a DocuSign link. If you need us to accept a partially completed packet and finish over call, we can set 20 minutes next week.

Best,
Priya Natarajan
Procurement Operations | Redwood Inference
